svg.title: Triangle rasterization with edge functions
svg.text: Each thread tests its pixel center against three edges; all three positive means inside. The values are also the blend weights.
All three >= 0, so the pixel is inside. wA + wB + wC = 2856 = twice the area.
The same test, in hardware terms:
MAD R2, R5, R0, R6 ; wA = a*Px + b*Py + c
QMUL R2, R2, R7 ; weight -> red
Real GPUs do this in a fixed-function rasterizer that
tests many pixels per cycle, then launch a pixel shader
thread for each covered pixel. Pixelstorm does both in
the shader: one thread per pixel.
